author: IGN
description:
WWE stars CM Punk and Paul Heyman share their GOAT picks with IGN, answering stupid questions like their GOAT pizza topping and emoji, and also giving us thoughtful answers to things like their GOAT piece of advice and GOAT small joy that always makes life better. 

We also dig into their WWE picks for things like their favourite WWE entrance (that isn't theirs!) and what they think is the greatest WWE crowd reaction of all time.

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Exclusive Clip for Beam Me Up, Sulu, a documentary telling the story of a long-lost 1985 Star Trek fan film distributed by Highway Child. Explore an unseen relic of pop culture history in Beam Me Up, Sulu, releasing on digital on February 17.

Beam Me Up, Sulu is more than a story about a lost fan film. It’s a journey through the changing landscape of American pop culture, the evolving portrayal of minorities in Hollywood, and the enduring power of science fiction to inspire social progress.

Beam Me Up, Sulu stars George Takei, Stan Woo, Garrett Wang, Rod Roddenberry, Christina Chong, Alexander Siddig, and more. The documentary is directed by Timour Gregory and Sasha Schneider, alongside being produced by Sasha Schneider, Timour Gregory, Ashu Rai, and Matthew Drake.

Beam Me Up, Sulu is releasing on digital on February 17.
title: Beam Me Up, Sulu - Exclusive Clip (2026) George Takei

author: IGN
description:
In this exclusive deleted scene from 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple, Sir Lord Jimmy Crystal (Jack O'Connell) and Dr. Ian Kelson (Ralph Fiennes) part ways after their initial meeting, just as the infected Alpha Samson (Chi Lewis-Parry) arrives with a howl of rage.
The scene is an interesting look at how Jimmy feels about the Alphas -- namely, that he's terrified by them. He's survived these 28 years for a reason, you know!

#ign
title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple - Deleted Scene 'Bend to His Will' (2026) Ralph Fiennes
